scope.flow: deposit() share-minting order in the gHYBR vault
scope.environment: vault contract with veNFT lock accounting; veTokenId != 0 and _totalSupply > 0

entities.name: gHYBR vault contract providing deposit() and calculateShares()

statements.text: The vault has a nonzero veTokenId, so totalAssets() reflects the veNFT's locked amount.
There are existing depositors, i.e. _totalSupply is greater than zero (not the very first deposit).
A new depositor calls deposit() with a positive HYBR amount.
In deposit(), the contract locks the deposited HYBR into the veNFT before calculateShares(amount) is called.
deposit() locks the deposited HYBR into the veNFT.
deposit() calls calculateShares(amount), which pulls the denominator from totalAssets().
deposit() mints gHYBR shares computed by calculateShares(amount).
Because the deposit is locked before share calculation, totalAssets() is larger by the deposit amount when calculateShares() runs, inflating the denominator and reducing the minted shares.
A new depositor receives fewer gHYBR shares than fair value, e.g. 50 gHYBR instead of 100.
The shortfall in minted shares increases existing holders' per-share entitlement, redistributing value to them.

In deposit(), the shares minted to a depositor should be computed on totalAssets() measured before that deposit's HYBR is locked, so a nonzero veTokenId and existing supply do not reduce the depositor's shares below the fair proportional amount.
The report treats calculateShares() as the preview/fair-value reference, so a deposit should mint the amount implied by a pre-deposit totalAssets() reading.

ambiguities: Report does not identify who calls deposit() or whether callers are restricted.
No transaction, block, or address is used to show an actual observed under-mint; the 100→200 / 50-share case is presented as an example.
No fragment states the exact pre-deposit totalAssets()/totalSupply() prior state for a real deposit; prior state is reconstructed from the example.
Report does not state whether the depositor can preview calculateShares() before making the deposit.
